name: Philippines (RA 9184)
description: Custom procurement policy and transparency indicators for Philippines Government Procurement Reform Act context

indicators.name: Non-competitive method above threshold
indicators.description: Direct/limited procurement above value threshold (RA 9184 policy check).
indicators.tracks: Use of non-open procurement methods on high-value processes.

steps: Compare tender/value/amount to configured PHP threshold tiers.
Flag for manual RA 9184 mode eligibility review.

indicators.interpretation: High-value non-competitive awards warrant legal review even when procedurally valid.

indicators.name: Competitive procedure, no bidders disclosed
indicators.description: Open/selective procedure with no bids block — transparency gap, not proven single bid.
indicators.tracks: Competitive notice published without disclosed participants.

computation.summary: procurementMethod ∈ {open, selective} AND bids/details absent or empty
steps: Check for absence of bids/details[] or empty tenderers.
Do not infer single bid — distinct from R018.

indicators.interpretation: Missing bidder disclosure on a competitive procedure is a transparency failure.
indicators.limitations: ~54% of competitive releases lack bidder lists in flat CSV — treat as unknown vs confirmed non-disclosure.

paths.note: Absence of bids is the signal

indicators.name: Award value vs budget overrun
indicators.description: Award amount significantly exceeds approved budget (ABC).
indicators.tracks: Contract award value exceeding approved budget of the contract (ABC).

steps: Compute ratio at process level after grouping line items.

indicators.interpretation: May indicate scope creep, change orders, or data errors.

indicators.name: Award before bid closing
indicators.description: Award date precedes tender submission deadline.
indicators.tracks: Whether award was recorded before the bid closing datetime.
indicators.interpretation: Suggests procedural error, backdated records, or inadequate notice.

indicators.name: Same-day award after closing
indicators.description: Award published on the same calendar day as bid closing (minimal deliberation window).
indicators.tracks: Compressed timeline between bid close and award notice.

steps: Compare calendar dates of award and closing.

indicators.interpretation: Complements R003 (short submission period) — flags rushed post-close processing.

indicators.name: High-value tender missing UNSPSC
indicators.description: Competitive or high-value tender without item classification (UNSPSC).
indicators.tracks: Missing product/service classification on material procurements.
indicators.interpretation: Reduces transparency and weakens category-based analysis (see also R048).

indicators.name: Award value without disclosed supplier
indicators.description: Contract amount published but awardee identity missing.
indicators.tracks: Award value disclosed without supplier id or name.

computation.summary: awards/value/amount present AND awards/suppliers absent or empty
steps: Check awards/suppliers[] for id or name.

indicators.interpretation: Opposite transparency gap to PH-C02 — value published but winner hidden.

paths.note: Either id or name satisfies disclosure

indicators.name: Competitive label with SVP or shopping details
indicators.description: procurementMethod is open/selective but procurementMethodDetails suggests SVP, shopping, or negotiated mode.
indicators.tracks: Inconsistency between competitive method code and mode label text.

computation.summary: procurementMethod ∈ {open, selective} AND details match SVP/shopping/negotiated patterns
steps: Match details against SVP, shopping, small-value, negotiated labels.
Flag mismatches for mapping review or circumvention screening.

indicators.interpretation: May indicate misclassification, data entry error, or mode circumvention.
indicators.limitations: Requires maintained label pattern list for Philippine mode strings.
